title: The Genre Neuron
headline: A calibration neuron with two clean poles that have nothing to do with each other. Layer 10, neuron 5749 of 1-bit Bonsai-8B fires on the genre or form of creative work at one pole, and on refuelling at gas stations at the other.
summary: Forward: a blind agent labelled the poles from corpus examples alone, as genre or artistic form (+) and refuelling vehicles (−). On its 132-sentence bank, both labels separate on-concept from off-concept text perfectly (AUROC 1.00 for each pole), and nothing off-concept passes 0.3.

Held-out: 24 new sentences written from the label alone. 9 of 12 predicted to fire did, including German, Russian, Italian, Spanish and French 'genre'. None of the 12 near misses fired: Spanish 'género' meaning gender, 'generic' drugs, 'genus', tax forms, petrol stations.
Inverse: no solver could make it fire with nothing related present (best 0.29). globalMOO hit 25, 50 and 75% targets in 7–10 evaluations.

Induce: pushing it negative makes the model talk about gasoline, petrol and pumps; pushing it positive raises 'genre', 'literary', 'tradition', 'archetype'. Cross-talk between the poles is about 0.005: each ignores the other's concept.
offshoots: 'forms' of poetry and music fire weakly (0.2–0.25)
